# Yahoo!知恵袋 (Yahoo! Chiebukuro)

> > Japan's leading Q&A community platform where users ask and answer questions across diverse topics including entertainment, daily life, legal matters, and hobbies.

Yahoo!知恵袋 (Yahoo! Answers Japan) is a crowdsourced knowledge platform covering questions ranging from Japanese language usage and traffic laws to anime discussions and gaming terminology. Each detail page represents a specific question-answer thread contributed by the community.

## Key Topics

- Yahoo!知恵袋 community knowledge
- Japanese language usage (以降 and other terms)
- 道路交通法 (Road Traffic Act) - Articles 17, 25, 25-2
- Traffic law and driving rules
- Pedestrian safety and sidewalk crossing
- 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン (Neon Genesis Evangelion)
- エヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版 (Rebuild of Evangelion films)
- Social games and gacha mechanics
- Card rarity systems (HR, LR, SR, SSR)
- Mobile game terminology
- Commute route documentation
- JR railway system
- Employment forms and procedures

## Traffic Law and Driving Rules

- [Sidewalk Crossing Rules and Traffic Law](https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q10102349850): Q&A on traffic law regarding sidewalk crossing and left turns

## Entertainment and Anime

- [Evangelion: Old vs New Theatrical Version Differences](https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q10105972535): Q&A comparing Evangelion old vs new theatrical versions' plot

## Gaming and Mobile Games

- [Social Game Rarity Terminology (HR, LR, SR, SSR)](https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q10102243595): Q&A about social game rarity terminology (HR, LR, SR, SSR)

## Employment and Daily Life

- [How to Fill Out Commute Route Information](https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q10110265660): Q&A about filling out commute route information on employment forms

## Japanese Language Usage

- [Meaning of '以降' (ijō) - Does It Include the Base Time?](https://detail.chiebukuro.yahoo.co.jp/qa/question_detail/q1011117710): Q&A about Japanese word meaning: does '以降' include the base time?
